listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Tobacco Absolute Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A woody fragrance matures the senses with complex, time-honoured notes of tobacco, cedarwood and fiery ginger in this seasoned Eau de Parfum. The fragrance: Top notes of ginger, bergamot and wine accords A heart of tobacco, cedarwood, violet and orris A base of Peruvian balsam and patchouli Olfactive Signature: Nutmeg. Fragrance family: Woody. Explore: London via San Pedro. Rain-splashed tobacco plants dot plots of ruby soil. A nutmeg spiced haze engulfs deeply furrowed fields. Tobacco leaves hang like pendants in open-sided barns; their vast furling forms striking and redolent with sticky, deep mahogany. Enrich your life with olfactory tradition. Profound. Earthy. Cultivated.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Marrakech Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: This bold fragrance takes its primary inspirations from the city of Marrakech: the aromas of spices used in its traditional dishes, the intense colours characteristic of the local souks and the surrounding desert, and the warm hospitality integral to Moroccan traditions. It balances spice notes with Jasmine, Neroli and Bergamot to captivating effect.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club New York Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Elevated, sensual and commanding, Ralph's Club New York is a seductive fragrance inspired by the vibrancy of New York City. It opens with a burst of juicy blackcurrant accord, used for the first time in a men's fragrance, before giving way to a blend of creamy vanilla and warm sandalwood notes. The distinctive bottle is designed with a silver translucent finish inspired by a polished gentleman's flask and features a black rhombus 'R' diamond monogram as a homage to the architectural heritage of its namesake city and Ralph Lauren's hometown. Olfactive family: Fougere, Ambery. Top notes: Blackcurrant Accord, Wrinkled Leaves Accord, Green Italian Mandarin, Bergamot Calabria Heart Middle notes: Lavender, Geranium Oil Madagascar, Sandalwood Base notes: Moss Accord, Fir Balsam Duo (resinoid and absolute), Bourbon Vanilla Madagascar

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Zafferano Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: In Acqua di Parma's Zafferano, the warm and dry notes of saffron are distilled and combined with luminous notes of Italian golden fruits, like gilded sparks dancing with the intense spicy notes to create an unexpected and vibrant sensation. Italianity meets the ingredient’s origin land, the Middle East in Venice, the historical European gateway along the ancient spice route that represents a metaphorical intersection between East and West, embodying charm and mystery, richness, and dissimulation. The essence of an intimate, never ostentatious luxury that can only be fully appreciated and understood by those who know their history. An unexpected juxtaposition, an olfactory translation of the Venetian terrazzo’s compositional technique, in which precious materials such as gold, marble and Murano glass are combined with mastery to create an objet d’art. A touch of flowers shines through the essential oils of orange blossom, jasmine sambac and geranium, further enhancing the heart of the composition. The woody and amber notes of tonka bean and vanilla soften the dusky accents of saffron, creating an intriguing and unexpected harmony. An exquisite experience that unfolds over time. A radiant interpretation of the precious and soft scent of Saffron. Ambery Woody. Top Notes: Mandarine, Bergamot, Coriander, Orange Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Geranium, Rose, Saffron, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Vaniglia, Tonka Bean, Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès’ perfumer Christine Nagel, Le Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette is a surprising garden that it's neither green nor floral, but... blond. It is the expression of an olfactory quest through Greece that leads to Kythira, an unspoiled island that has inspired many artists. A citrus and woody fragrance, Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette combines enveloping notes of grasses with the strength of olive wood and the tenderness of fresh pistachio. Designed by Fred Rawyler, the bottle is inspired by the lines of the horse-drawn carriage lanterns of yesteryear. The luminous graduated yellow glass echoes the sunny fragrance. On the box, artist Elias Kafouros sketches a colourful landscape of his homeland: golden grasses, green olive trees, fresh pink pistachios and, in the background, the blue of the sea. The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the inspiration of the perfumer and the theme chosen by Hermès each year to illuminate its creation. An olfactory stroll to share for every moment, to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.description: Lys 41 is an overwhelming white floral - a blend of jasmine, tuberose absolute and lily, bewitching in its noble, warm and sunny approach yet treacherous once caught in its web of noble woods, vanilla Madagascar and musks. The fragrance rewards those looking for a statement with an addictive floral buzz that is as potent as its wake and as insistent as the people following you around. Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Rouge L'Interdit Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A floral woody gourmand fragrance blending luscious Black Cherry with a White Flower Bouquet. More magnetic, sensual, and bold than ever, L'Interdit Elixir by Givenchy unveils a striking new facet of femininity with its intense, captivating trail. A fragrance with magnetic power: From the very first notes, indulgent dark Black Cherry reveals a vibrant and sensual intensity. At its heart, the iconic L'Interdit signature white floral bouquet of Orange Blossom, Tuberose and Jasmine Sambac blends elegantly with Pure Oakwood Extract, giving the fragrance a deep intensity, enhanced by notes of Rum, Davana and Vanilla. A deeply sensual fragrance for women who seek to leave a lasting impression. A bottle crafted like a jewel: Inspired by the ruby, the L'Interdit bottle glows in an incandescent red that fades into black, designed to magnify the aura of the fragrance and evoke the rarest, most intense shade of the precious stone. How to use: For a light touch: mist a cloud of fragrance around your head and shoulders, letting it fall gently over you For a medium intensity: spray in a Y-shape across the body, starting from one shoulder and finishing at the other For a richer intensity: apply directly on pulse points and warm areas (wrists, inside of the elbows, base of the neck). The warmth of your skin will reveal the full intensity of the fragrance

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: GOOD GIRL is inspired by Carolina Herrera’s unique vision of the duality of the modern woman: audacious and sexy, elegant and enigmatic, good and bad. Forever pushing and crossing the limit, the mysterious sensuality of GOOD GIRL makes for a modern yet sophisticated fragrance. For: Her When: All Day Type: Powerful & Daring POWER OF THE HEEL SHE’S GOOD ON ONE SIDE AND BAD ON THE OTHER The complex duality of modern femininity is captured in this sophisticated yet multifaceted women’s perfume. Reveal your good side – or your bad side – with the luminous facet of tuberose and best quality Sambac Jasmine contrasted with the dangerously addictive notes of roasted tonka beans and Cocoa. WELL BEHAVED GIRLS RARELY MAKE HISTORY Powerful, playful and a lady on the edge, the GOOD GIRL is never afraid to be herself, challenging the expectations of everyone she meets. Her magnetic sensuality captivates men and women alike as she knows exactly where and when to reveal her true self; good and bad. Informal elegance: Bulgarian rose, Jasmine sambac, Orange blossom, Praline, Cinnamon Freshness: Bergamot, lemon Comfort: Sandalwood, cedarwood, cashmere, Patchouli, Amber notes, Transparent musk POWERFUL, PROVOCATIVE AND UTTERLY COMPELLING: CAROLINA HERRERA CAPTURES THE NEW DIMENSIONS OF FEMININITY. GOOD GIRL, a boldly sophisticated scent in an astonishing new bottle that expresses women’s delicious duality. Complex and seemingly contradictory, this is a fragrance where sensibilities collide. She is the master of her own duality; ultra-feminine and powerful; sensual and irreverent; independent and fearless; and ultimately, brimming with intrigue. Women’s thrilling duality, which is brought to roaring life by the city that never sleeps, inspires a fragrance signed Carolina Herrera New York. The GOOD GIRL is unforgettable; she captivates us with her confidence, mesmerises us with her contemporary elegance, charms us with her unbridled, untamable spirit. Carolina Herrera celebrates the exquisite power of femininity and the beautiful contradictions of a woman today in the most alluring of ways.

listings.description: J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime is available in a roll-on Roller-Pearl format, a travel-friendly bottle for an infinitely sensual perfuming gesture. The glass bead tip of the J'adore Roller-Pearl bottle delivers a soft and voluptuous application of the J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime. The velvety-soft pearl rolls over the pulse points: neck, wrist and décolleté, releasing its sensual and enveloping notes: centifolia rose, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, Grasse tuberose and creamy sandalwood. As the J'adore Roller-Pearl sensually glides over the skin, the flowers of J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime unfurl and exalt their scent infinitely.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Baie 19 Eau de Parfum Travel Refill, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Truth is...Baie 19 should have been called Water 19. Not that it smells like nothing (though nothing smells like it), but it has this crisp, wet, drenched effect that water gives to the earth after the rain...And there’s a word for that, by the way: petrichor. It’s that magical feeling during heavy rain after a long dry spell, and it’s one of the most beautiful olfactive phenomena in nature. There are many reasons for this, including the ozone in the air, the negative ions, but most importantly the release of oil secretions from certain plants, accumulated after a long dry period. This is what Baie 19 is about: the dry juniper berry, the patchouli, the green leaves... all soaked by a beautiful, luminous, magnetic rain after a long drought. And the joy that comes with it... Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani unveils Armani Code Eau de Parfum, a new compelling and vibrant intensity, encapsulated in the iconic Armani Code refillable bottle. A new fougère ambery spicy fragrance that opens with a faceted freshness with notes of green mandarin and unfolds into a spicy and woody heart of nutmeg essence. A masculine sensuality emerges from the fragrance’s base through a rich and warm tonka bean absolute. Armani Code Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh and vibrant green mandarin essence, sourced from Italy, which brings a distinctive tangy effect to the fragrance. This essence is obtained by grating the zest of the mandarin fruit under running water, with the essence then separated from the water. The heart of the fragrance is composed of a warm and spicy nutmeg essence. The nutmeg essence, derived from the fruit of the nutmeg trees, is obtained via a meticulous drying and steam distillation process, to create its warm, spicy, and woody note. A warm, sensual masculinity is revealed in the fragrance’s base notes, which spotlight the richness of tonka bean absolute. Creating a honeyed tobacco note with milky undertones, the tonka bean absolute is derived from the fruit of the Dipterix odorata tree. The fruits are harvested just as they fall from the tree and undergo a drying process to allow the development of the coumarin molecule, that lends tonka its scent. The absolute is then obtained using a solvent extraction method. How to use: Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long-lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau de Parfum Refillable 125ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani unveils Armani Code Eau de Parfum, a new compelling and vibrant intensity, encapsulated in the iconic Armani Code refillable bottle. A new fougère ambery spicy fragrance that opens with a faceted freshness with notes of green mandarin and unfolds into a spicy and woody heart of nutmeg essence. A masculine sensuality emerges from the fragrance’s base through a rich and warm tonka bean absolute. Armani Code Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh and vibrant green mandarin essence, sourced from Italy, which brings a distinctive tangy effect to the fragrance. This essence is obtained by grating the zest of the mandarin fruit under running water, with the essence then separated from the water. The heart of the fragrance is composed of a warm and spicy nutmeg essence. The nutmeg essence, derived from the fruit of the nutmeg trees, is obtained via a meticulous drying and steam distillation process, to create its warm, spicy, and woody note. A warm, sensual masculinity is revealed in the fragrance’s base notes, which spotlight the richness of tonka bean absolute. Creating a honeyed tobacco note with milky undertones, the tonka bean absolute is derived from the fruit of the Dipterix odorata tree. The fruits are harvested just as they fall from the tree and undergo a drying process to allow the development of the coumarin molecule, that lends tonka its scent. The absolute is then obtained using a solvent extraction method. How to use: Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long-lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.

listings.description: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light, a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk. TOM FORD’s winter world conjures the thrill of a day on the slopes that melts into the celebratory warmth of après-ski. A cool burst of bright and green citrus gives way to a bouquet of winter-white florals and rose absolute. Fragrance family: Citrus Scent type: Citrus Musk

listings.description: When tulips start blooming, it is the sign that Spring has sprung. With the dull days of winter at an end, gardens come to life with bold colours and clean-cut shapes. Tulips may not be the first flowers you would think of as being fragrant, but a number are definitely sweet-smelling. Notes: Top: Cyclamen, Freesia, Rhubarb Heart: Tulip Base: Blonde Woods, Vetiver

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria, an enchanting Eau de Toilette that celebrates the majestic Calabria and its golden Bergamot fruit. Bergamotto di Calabria is characterised by effervescent top notes of bergamot fruits. At the heart of this Eau de Toilette, accords of red ginger and cedar wood bring a calming note while the base is rounded off with a unique combination of vetiver, benzoin, and musk. Bergamotto di Calabria comes in the iconic Acqua di Parma bottle with Art Deco influences. The glass, which is pure, luxurious, and thick, is tinged with a deep blue in a play of reflections that evokes the transparency of the sea.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum 60ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: I Want Choo is a powerful floral gourmand woody fragrance that explodes with joy and good humour, finished with a seductive twist. It is the incarnation of the true Jimmy woman: glamorous, confident, playful and always full of joy. The sensual fragrance is inspired by the atmosphere when friends are getting ready to party the night away. It is not about going out; it is all about sharing the fun, the laughter and making it a girls' night in to remember. On top, a citrus note of mandarin juice contrasts with the suave, velvety peach nuances. The carnal and solar vanilla-like notes of the red spider lily blend in with the sensual vibes of jasmine sambac in the heart. The base notes of vanilla and benzoin anchor the fragrance in a deep, yet joyful way, leaving an intense vapour trail behind. Set contains: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum, 60ml Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Perfumed Body Lotion, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This holiday season, explore the unexpected wonders of the light-filled Issey Miyake fragrance gift sets. Designed in collaboration with creative director Yorgo Tloupas, the exclusive boxes echo Issey Miyake's iconic aesthetic, captivating the senses through refined geometric patterns. For this modern floral ambery fragrance, perfumer duo Fabrice Pellegrin and Marie Salamagne have translated light into a scent for an eau de parfum as radiant as a sunrise. Sparkling top notes of organic green mandarin open the perfume with a bright and zesty start. At the heart, solar notes of orange blossom diffuse a generous sunlit aura. Addictive base notes of a pistachio wood accord blend with creamy sandalwood. For a warm and sensual fragrance with a powerful luminosity. Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum is a vegan fragrance made with 90% natural-origin ingredients, including 100% natural-origin French alcohol. Set contains: Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum, 50ml Lumière d’Issey Moisturising Body Lotion, 50ml Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum Purse Spray, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Mojave Ghost L'Huile Parfum Roll-On Perfumed Oil, 7.5ml
listings.description: Roll-On Perfumed Oil delivers an intense hit of fragrance with a long-lasting effect, in an alcohol-free formulation. Housed in a travel-friendly glass vial, perfect for on-the-go application. Capturing the soulful beauty of the Mojave Desert, this scent draws on the rare ghost flowers that emerge amidst the arid wilderness. Fragile, translucent petals blooming atop sunbaked terrain: a miraculous moment of life in Death Valley. Delicate magnolia and powdery violet notes layered atop the hazy warmth of ambrette and cedarwood. Against a seductive landscape of musk, a fresh appearance of Jamaican Nesberry. A graceful, lingering spirit of slowly unfurling contrasts. Notes: Top: Ambrette Heart: Magnolia, Sandalwood, Violet Base: Cedarwood, Chantilly Musk, Crisp Amber

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon Endymion Eau de Cologne 100ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Begin your morning ritual in the most legendary manner. Endymion’s scent of suede, coffee and bergamot in a cologne and shaving cream, complete with a razor and Penhaligon's insignia tube key. With key notes of sage, coffee Absolute and frankincense, Endymion is sweet and softly masculine, a fusion of citrus, spices and leather. A limited edition gift set. listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Eau de Parfum Discovery Fragrance Gift Set,  5 x 7ml

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Coco Mademoiselle Eau De Toilette Twist and Spray
listings.description: The essence of a bold, free woman. An airy, sensual, feminine Amber. The eau de toilette comes in a "Twist And Spray" which you can slip into your purse. A simple twist envelops you in the lingering notes of Coco Mademoiselle. A fresh and airy Amber-floral accord. Top notes of Sicilian Grapefruit deliver an intense freshness, before giving way to a floral heart with a blend of Rose and Jasmine petals, punctuated with a fruity Lychee note. Softened base notes provide a unique and boldly seductive trail. The eau de toilette comes in a purse spray to revive the notes of the fragrance throughout the day. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is also available to enhance the fragrance trail. Refillable spray with two x 20ml refills

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Kopenhagen Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Climbing white roses open to the cool city air, merging with the soft mineral scent of stone after rain. Along the harbour, water moss mingles with a metallic accord of polished steel, reflecting the blend of ancient trading hub and modern creative pulse. Beneath the freshness, a trace of charred wood and pale musks adds warmth and depth in a contrast of purity and texture. Scent notes: Top: Blue aluminium Accord Middle: Cypress Essential Oil, Moss Accord Base: Cedarwood Essential Oil, Gaiacwood Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Sauvage Extrait, 50ml
listings.description: A men's fragrance icon and true to its pioneering spirit, Sauvage Extrait is Dior's first extrait de parfum for men. A composition of unprecedented intensity, matured for 42 days to reach its peak of intensity, resulting in ultimate long-lasting wear and power. The beating heart of the composition, the precious essence of Vietnamese oud, leaves its animalic imprint with leather notes in a rich blend of noble woods. In this denser and more woody interpretation, Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, imagined this intense trail that pushes the limits of concentration. The dark and enveloping essence of Indonesian patchouli contrasts with the light, creamy essences of Madagascan vetiver and Virginia cedarwood. A sensual and powerful base that is contrasted by a fresh and aromatic top accord of bergamot and an essence of AOP lavender from Provence. Its bottle, with its translucent interior lacquer – a true masterpiece of glasswork – evokes a drop of deep blue ink suspended in crystalline glass, engraved with the CD monogram. A signature that also adorns the cap, like a crown on the bottle. How to use: Spray Sauvage Extrait on pulse points, wrists and neck, to reveal a powerful and long-lasting olfactory imprint on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum 100ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Eros Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that embodies excess and provocation, boldly revealing its extremes: the stark contrast between the citrusy and the delicate. Rooted in the depth of its woody accord of cedar, vetiver, and patchouli, this foundation is ignited by the radiant, energetic light of the quintessentially Italian lemon and mandarin pairing, further enlivened by a unique note of candied apple. Decadent vanilla dares to flirt with leather in the final note, creating a fatal and provocative weapon with its distinctive, intoxicating and creamy effects, its vibrant contours, all enhancing its oriental character. Set contains: Eros Eau de Parfum, 100ml Eros Invigorating Shower Gel, 150ml Eros Eau de Parfum, Miniature, 5ml

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 10ml Travel Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Discover the essence of glamour with this miniature set of iconic Jimmy Choo fragrances, perfectly sized for travel. From joyful nights in to unforgettable evenings out, each scent celebrates confidence, friendship, and the spirit of fun. I Want Choo Le Parfum embodies the bold, glamorous, and exceptional craftsmanship synonymous with Jimmy Choo. I Want Choo Le Parfum is a playful, vibrant ode to empowering female friendships, evoking glamorous and memorable nights. This amber floral woody fragrance opens with vibrant notes of pear and is adorned by the solar inflection of golden gardenia. The middle notes combine a creamy, warm heart with sweet jasmine, irresistible patchouli, and ambrette. The glamorous base notes, blending with moss, amber, sandalwood, and praline accord, give the creation a long-lasting trail. Set contains: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum, 10ml Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum, 4.5ml

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Discovery Native Eau de Parfum Fragrance Gift Set, 10 x 2ml
listings.description: This Discovery Sample Collection contains 10 x 2ml perfume concentrate samples from the Native Collection by Goldfield & Banks. Sunset Hour is a heavenly cocktail of citrus, fruit and spicy delights that awaits, giving way to a deliciously gourmand and sensuous floral heart. With its invigorating opening of Australian caviar lime and coriander, Bohemian Lime mellows to reveal blissful grounding notes of vetiver, cedar wood and sandalwood. Pacific Rock Moss unveils a distinctive marine note, graced with aromatic essences, bringing you on a lush coastal walk on a beautiful summer day. Southern Bloom is an immediately lavish, pure, and sensational floral-woody fragrance, with a smooth, velvety sensation and glimpses of exquisite green notes. Wood Infusion is a luxe ambery scent, surrounded by an elixir of rich woods, buttery roots, and aromatic notes. Desert Rosewood is an unusual, resinous and comforting leathery fragrance that reveals an exceptional encounter between a rainbow of woods and the spectacular Australian desert under the burning sun. Blue Cypress unveils a haze of light incense that fuses with the scent of the morning dew evaporating from a deep blue-green forest. White Sandalwood is a heavenly, sophisticated scent that stands out because of its unique blend of exotic spices and rich wood. Velvet splendour is like holding a large bunch of sunburnt wildflowers in both arms and pressing one's face gently into it. Transportive and Seductive, Ingenious Ginger offers an instant sense of nature in a blissful and sultry destination. A solar perfume of sun-kissed mandarin, spicy ginger, elegant white florals, and warm, enveloping amber that cascades across your skin. Set contains: Sunset Hour Eau de Parfum, 2ml Bohemian Lime Eau de Parfum, 2ml Pacific Rock Moss Eau de Parfum, 2ml Southern Bloom Eau de Parfum, 2ml Wood Infusion Eau de Parfum, 2ml Desert Rosewood Eau de Parfum, 2ml Blue Cypress Eau de Parfum, 2ml White Sandalwood Eau de Parfum, 2ml Velvet Splendour Eau de Parfum, 2ml Ingenious Ginger Eau de Parfum, 2ml
